svg.title: Mature city nominal parcel-envelope map
svg.desc: Overhead map showing every valid nominal parcel envelope, actual road links, the river corridor, and station nodes. Envelope colors indicate floors; outlines distinguish open and construction-stage buildings. Parcel-envelope area and floor-area ratios are proxies, not actual building geometry.
